summary.overview:
- Andrea Paola has 25 years of experience in financial services, with expertise in trading operations and freelancing in lead generation; based in Miami, currently visiting family in Bolivia.
- Andy Day is located in Somerset, UK, conducting the recorded interview for a team member position at Deal Engines.
- Deal Engines specializes in M&A advisory for marketing agencies, and recently acquired a marketing agency to enhance deal flow for business buyers.
- The company's platform is similar to Apollo and Instantly, targeting potential business sellers through LinkedIn and cold email campaigns.
- The team comprises 8 members: 6 involved in M&A and 2 focused on buying/selling business groups, with tri-weekly meetings for collaboration.
- The role involves enhancing customer journey and assisting M&A advisors in identifying potential sellers across various industries.
- Team members can earn a portion of win fees, which could exceed $250,000, incentivizing collaboration and performance.
- A new platform is set to launch next week, aimed at creating a level playing field for all team members in deal acquisitions.
- Presentable communication skills are necessary for effective interaction with business owners and information gathering for the M&A process.
- A trial period is proposed for the middle to end of next week, coinciding with the launch of the new system; Andrea expressed strong interest and availability.
summary.short_summary: Andrea Paola, with 25 years of experience in financial services and expertise in trading operations and lead generation, interviewed for a team member position at Deal Engines, a company specializing in M&A advisory for marketing agencies. The firm recently acquired a marketing agency to improve deal flow and has a team of 8 members who meet tri-weekly to enhance collaboration. The role aims to improve the customer journey and assist M&A advisors in identifying potential sellers across various sectors. Team members have the opportunity to earn substantial win fees, incentivizing high performance. A new platform launching next week will support equitable deal acquisitions, and presentable communication skills are essential for engaging with business owners. Andrea expressed keen interest in the role and is available for a trial period coinciding with the platform’s launch.
